assessment.nobel_worthiness: Public knowledge supports a highly distinctive, immediately recognizable voice. Dense, visionary, densely patterned prose, as in the Blinding trilogy and Solenoid, turns memory, the body and dream into a large metaphysical project. It combines formal ambition with sustained imaginative and intellectual depth, and is also supported by his poetry. Within the framework of Nobel's will, the case rests on the idealistic, far-reaching scope of the project.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer citation is straightforward. It could cite the renewal of the Romanian novel through an inward, encyclopedic imagination spanning poetry and prose.
assessment.maturity: A multi-decade oeuvre with a clear arc from poetry to the large-scale prose works. Quality appears sustained, and the late major work has not been superseded by a decline.
uncertainties: The prose depends heavily on rhythm and syntax, so my assessment relies on translations and reception rather than the Romanian original.
I have not independently verified the sources, and my coverage of the full corpus, especially the poetry and essays, is incomplete.
Whether the metaphysical sprawl sustains quality across every volume is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Compressed, syntactically exacting prose with a very distinct voice. Small Lives and The Eleven turn obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry, concentrating the French literary tradition into an extremely economical body of work. The achievement is formal and linguistic more than expansive.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation would focus on the invention of a condensed, historically saturated prose form that confers the weight of fate on minor lives.
assessment.maturity: A relatively small corpus, but one of high consistency from the 1980s onward. Depth comes through concentration rather than volume.
uncertainties: Much of the effect lies in the French sentence, so translation loss is substantial and my judgment is partly secondhand.
The oeuvre's modest breadth may weigh against it under the criterion of significance across a body of work.
I have not independently verified the sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative, morally attentive prose with a recognizable voice. Housekeeping and Gilead join theology, family and American history in a manner of real linguistic discipline, and her essays extend the same intellectual concerns. The idealistic dimension of the Nobel will is arguably well served by her moral and spiritual seriousness.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer citation is clear, covering fiction and essays; the Gilead sequence forms a coherent sub-project.
assessment.maturity: A deliberately small novelistic output across several decades, with sustained quality in the novels I know of. The late Gilead-cycle novels continue and deepen earlier concerns.
uncertainties: Oeuvre breadth in fiction is limited, and the essays' weight relative to the novels is uncertain.
The later novels' formal novelty relative to the early work is debatable.
I have not independently verified the sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radically inward and unmistakable voice. In The Plains and Border Districts, landscape, memory and mental images become a self-consistent system built from a stringent prose method. The distinctiveness is very high and the formal commitment is rigorous.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is unambiguous. A citation would center on the construction of an interior geography of memory and imagery through a singular, self-reflexive prose.
assessment.maturity: A long and consistent career with strong internal coherence. Recognition came late, and the late works extend rather than dilute the method.
uncertainties: The very narrow thematic range and self-referential method may limit the breadth of significance.
I may be under-weighting or over-weighting individual works because my knowledge of the full corpus is partial.
I have not independently verified the sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Danube and Microcosms blend travel writing, essay and fiction into a hybrid mapping of Central European borderlands, memory and intellectual history. The humanistic and intellectual depth is substantial, and the formal inventiveness is real, though more erudite than strikingly voice-driven in my reading of reception.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation could concern the creation of a European literary form linking culture, history and place.
assessment.maturity: A long career of scholarly and literary work with sustained intellectual quality. The strongest claims rest on works from the 1980s and 1990s.
uncertainties: Much of the impact resides in the essay-narrative mix, and the weight of fiction versus nonfiction is uncertain.
Translation and my limited reading of the Italian corpus restrict confidence about the prose's distinctiveness.
I have not independently verified the sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Grotesque, mythic and satirical forms, as in The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles, expose the violence of ideology and development through formal invention, with a theory-laden approach he has called mythorealism. The imaginative and moral range is considerable.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear; a citation would focus on inventive narrative response to modern Chinese history. Political circumstances, including censorship, should not by themselves serve as evidence of merit.
assessment.maturity: A prolific career with several major works. Variation in quality across so large an output is a legitimate question.
uncertainties: Reliance on translations of Chinese prose makes stylistic evaluation tentative.
How consistently the formal inventiveness is sustained across the full oeuvre is unclear to me.
I have not independently verified the sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Public knowledge supports a major role in remaking modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and engagement with inherited forms (Songs of Mihyar the Damascene; A Time Between Ashes and Roses), plus influential critical essays. The linguistic and formal ambition is high, and his position within the Arabic tradition is significant.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation would cover poetic innovation in Arabic and the accompanying essayistic work.
assessment.maturity: A very long career with demonstrated influence. Durability is evident, though the relative quality of late work is uncertain to me.
uncertainties: Poetry in Arabic is especially hard to assess in translation, so claims about voice and prosody are indirect.
The weight of his essays and political writing versus the poetry is uncertain.
I have not independently verified the sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A sustained novelistic oeuvre addressing colonial memory, gender and changing Portuguese society, including The Murmuring Coast and The Wind Whistling in the Cranes. The historical and psychological scope and the social depth are of high quality, with a convincing narrative voice.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation would stress fiction that examines the colonial war's legacy and the moral and social transformation of Portugal.
assessment.maturity: A long career with continuous production since the 1980s. The strongest evidence of achievement is in the novels I know, though the consistency of the later work is uncertain to me.
uncertainties: My knowledge of the Portuguese-language corpus and its translations is limited, so judgments of linguistic achievement are partial.
Formal radicalism relative to some other candidates is harder to establish.
I have not independently verified the sources.
